snippet.title: STONED Demo Trailer - IndieMania 2025 Exlcusive
snippet.description:
This trailer was showcased exclusively at @indiemania 2025!

The demo trailer for STONED!
Three stoners accidentally gain magical powers from the soul of an Ancient Cosmic Wizard and discover their part in a huge prophecy to resurrect said Wizard, but since they’re too lazy to do that, they instead go on an adventure to get the soul removed from them. Shenanigans ensue. 
A unique turn-based RPG with “pong-style” battle mechanics!

(All things showcased are subject to change)

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3464390/STONED/

Join our discord server for updates on the game:
